name: BRC Asia Limited
summary: BRC Asia Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the prefabrication of steel reinforcement for use in concrete in Singapore, Australia, Brunei, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, India, and internationally. It operates through Fabrication and Manufacturing, Trading, and Others segments. The company is involved in the trading of steel reinforcing bars; and manufacture and sale of wire mesh fences. It also provides reinforcing steel products; mesh, cages, wires, and rebars; as well as prefabrication, cut, and bend services. BRC Asia Limited was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Singapore. BRC Asia Limited is a subsidiary of Green Esteel Pte. Ltd.
